name: application-interview-scorecard
title: Interview Scorecard
description: Interview evaluation card: per-competency rows with a 1-5 rating scale and a short note, an overall notes textarea, and a strong-hire/hire/no-hire recommendation selector.
useWhen: Building an applicant tracking system's post-interview feedback form.
You need a structured, multi-competency evaluation rather than a single overall score.
Distinct from NPS Rating Scale, which is a single 0-10 satisfaction score, not a multi-competency structured evaluation with notes.
avoidWhen: You only need a single overall score with no per-competency breakdown — a simpler rating input is enough.
The feedback is unstructured free text with no rating scale at all — a plain textarea/comment field fits better.
responsiveBehavior: Competency rows keep the label and rating scale on one line; the rating buttons are fixed-size and never wrap independently of their row.
accessibility: Each competency's rating scale is a role="radiogroup" of role="radio" buttons with aria-checked reflecting the selected value, matching single-select semantics.
The notes textarea has a real associated <label htmlFor>.
The recommendation selector's active choice is conveyed by both a filled background and the button's own label text, not color alone.

variants.title: Interview Scorecard
variants.description: A scorecard for Priya Shah (Senior Product Designer) with Communication rated 4/5 and System design rated 2/5, each with a short note, an additional-notes textarea, and a Strong hire recommendation selected.
accessibility: Rating buttons use role="radio" within a role="radiogroup" per competency, so each scale is announced as an independent single-select group.

variants.title: Interview Scorecard (Dark)
variants.description: The same scorecard adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Rating dot fill and recommendation selection remain distinguishable at dark-surface contrast.
